rationale: The assistant correctly identified side-wall condenser heat at the outset and ultimately concluded 'Yes, it is safe to keep using it as it is for now', matching the hidden truth. However it detoured into a confidently stated but unverified clearance rule ('Most manufacturers require at least 5cm'), ignored the customer's offer of the actual manual, told them to pull the unit out, then gave physically impossible spacer advice ('force at least 2-3cm' in a 1cm gap) and contradicted itself on technician vs fitter, visibly confusing the customer. It never asked about a warm plug or temperatures (the customer volunteered them) and repeatedly asserted the appliance would 'continue to overheat' despite it cooling perfectly at 4C and -18C. A stray 'check a suitable replacement' panel appeared but no part was recommended.
